visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat and white crochet top, smiling broadly as she holds a capybara wearing a festive collar. (3) The woman stands atop a zebra-patterned safari truck in an outdoor enclosure, holding branches and surrounded by several giraffes reaching for the food. (4) Back at the rocky waterfall setting, the woman sits and hugs the capybara tightly, looking delighted. (5) The woman kneels in an enclosure next to a large tiger lying on the ground, with a small monkey perched on the tiger's back. (6) Sitting on a wooden bench, the woman is covered by nearly a dozen small squirrel monkeys climbing on her arms, shoulders, and hat; she looks pleasantly overwhelmed. (7) She stands by a wire fence, looking out at a large concrete pool filled with dozens of crocodiles. (8) Top-down view of the crocodile pool with many large reptiles basking and swimming. (9) Close-up of one crocodile with its jaws wide open. (10) The woman laughs as the monkeys continue to crawl on her; a second person is partially visible holding a phone to record them. (11) The woman is sitting on the hood of the safari truck with giraffes in the background. (12) Rapid montage of her hugging the capybara and smiling at a monkey up close.
